test_title: PYST 07: SSC Stenographer 2025: General Awareness (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question:
Consider the following statements regarding the structure of Carnatic music compositions and choose correct option:

Statement 1: Varnam is typically performed at the end of a Carnatic concert to summarize key ragas.

Statement 2: Alapana involves improvisational elaboration of a raga without rhythm (tala).
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Only 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **Carnatic music**, the structure and components of compositions are highly organized and follow traditional patterns.
 
• **Statement 1 is incorrect:** Varnam is not performed at the end of a Carnatic concert. Instead, it is typically performed at the beginning as a warm-up piece to introduce the key raga and set the tone for the concert.
 
• **Statement 2 is correct:** Alapana is an improvisational aspect of Carnatic music that involves the **elaboration of a raga** without rhythm (tala). It is an expressive and free-form exploration of the raga's melodic framework.
 
• **Alapana** focuses on the mood and emotion of the raga, offering the performer creative freedom to showcase the raga's essence.
 
• Varnam, in contrast, is a structured composition that has lyrics and rhythm, typically used as a learning tool for students and as a concert starter.
 
• Alapana is an essential feature of Carnatic music concerts, especially in the presentation of kritis (main compositions).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Varnam**__

 __
 
• Varnam is a type of composition that is primarily used as a practice piece in Carnatic music.
 
• It serves as a foundation for students to master both **raga and tala**.
 
• Varnams are generally performed at the beginning of a concert to warm up the voice and introduce the raga.
 
 
 
• **Alapana**__
 
 
• Alapana is a creative and improvisational aspect of Carnatic music.
 
• It is devoid of lyrics and rhythm and is performed to provide an outline of the raga.
 
• This segment highlights the artist's command over the raga and their ability to innovate within its framework.
